reconcile.note: Keil and Delitzsch read the 'little son' of Genesis 9:24 as comparative rather than superlative, making the standard list order itself reflect relative age.

sides.snippet: Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
sides.verseText: Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

sides.snippet: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.
